project_music_style: Sparse Midwestern indie-drama score; low strings and distant guitar; avoid needle-drop rock except brief diegetic bar cue; silence as pressure; later Seattle cues cooler and thinner.

scenes.score_intent: Heavy domestic gravity; low drone under family routine.
scenes.timing: Enter under establishing shots; thin out for Nick entrance.
scenes.diegetic_sound: TV game show murmur; fridge; boots on floor.
scenes.silence_guidance: Hold silence after Nick door energy lands.
scenes.source_evidence: All she wants to do is watch game shows

scenes.score_intent: Sudden soft lift; almost tidal, gentle.
scenes.timing: Begin at shoulder brush; sustain under walk-away look-back.
scenes.source_evidence: That was like Sionna, except she was washing up on me

scenes.score_intent: Curious intellectual warmth; light piano figures.
scenes.timing: Under conversation montage; out on leaving to bus.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Cup clinks; backpack rustle; cafe bed.
scenes.source_evidence: When I looked into them, I lost all track of time

scenes.score_intent: Tight anxious pulse under Ma confusion and Nick anger.
scenes.timing: Build on glassy-eyed Ma look; spike on Nick blame.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Pill bottles; chair creak; door slam.
scenes.source_evidence: Her eyes were all glassy and looked really empty.

scenes.score_intent: Diegetic rock bed then score drops to heartbeat dread.
scenes.timing: Bar noise full; score enters only at fist draw; cut to run breath.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Crowd, pool, AC/DC-like bar track energy as ambience not licensed need; fists; door.
scenes.source_evidence: An old AC-DC song blared through

scenes.timing: Under officer words; sustain into hospital refusal beat if cut in.
scenes.silence_guidance: Long hold after 'passed away at the scene'.
scenes.source_evidence: I regret to tell you that your brother is in serious condition... and your mother passed away at the scene.

scenes.score_intent: Abrupt violence stinger then raw panic air.
scenes.timing: Silence before knock; stinger on blade; chaos through sirens.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Knock, struggle, body to wall, wet blood, sirens approaching.
scenes.silence_guidance: One second pure silence on first blood realization.
scenes.exclusions: No horror excess stingers beyond one.
scenes.source_evidence: The knife hits her hard and there is red flying out.

scenes.score_intent: Cool open Seattle air; lonely but freer tempo.
scenes.timing: Walk and memory flashes; resolve into flight decision.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Mist rain, traffic hush, ferry horn distant optional.
scenes.source_evidence: Many years had passed since my Milwaukee days.

scenes.score_intent: Bare; human voice primary; soft release chord after forgive.
scenes.timing: None under accusation; gentle resolve after 'I forgive you'.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Room fans, door locks, phone plastic, chair scrape.
scenes.silence_guidance: After hang-up, extended quiet walk out.
scenes.source_evidence: I forgive you, Nick, because it also releases your control over me forever
